doc: The narrowest map (2 columns): the only neighbour difference IS the seam, so the ratio is exactly 1. Mean |first column - last column| over mean |neighbour column difference| (the seam is NOT wrapped in the inner term). Means of float32 rows: the quotient is float32 and the tolerance float32 (observed 6.2e-8 relative against the same image promoted to float64).
